violations.text: The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. New Violation. Correct By: 07/21/2026

Raw animal foods (such as eggs and chicken) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (such as bread and produce) in the refrigerators. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. PIC relocated raw items. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/21/2026

Establishment was observed using re-usable utensils to serve meals. Establishment does not have a 3 bay sink to wash, rinse, and sanitize equipment and utensils. PIC switched the re-usable utensils with disposable utensils. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/21/2026

Milk was observed held at 55 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC placed in cooler for active cooling. New Violation. Correct By: 07/21/2026
Residential fridge (for members) located in the service area was not in good repair (ambient of 44F). PIC tweaked temperature down. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/21/2026
Establishment lacks 3 bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 07/21/2026

The establishment is lacking a 3-bay sink. Establishment uses mostly single-use articles and will switch to single-use serving equipment/utensils until a 3-bay sink has been installed. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 11/27/2023
